settings.heading: How to Return
settings.text:
When returning, please fill in the return form and place it together with your delivery note or invoice as well as the item(s) you wish to return.

  1. Print our return form
  2. Fill in the general points regarding customer name, order number, email address and order date.
  3. Fill in the product information individually on the returned item(s). Use the comment field if you want to give a detailed explanation.
  4. Pack the item(s) in the original packaging. The package must not be damaged during transport, therefore make sure that there are no loose items in the box.
  5. Attach your delivery note and completed return form.
  6. Download and apply a return label. Pedestal does not offer to pay for return labels, and you must therefore take care of this yourself. Make sure that your return label covers other labels that may already be on the packaging.
  7. Send the item(s) to:
    123 Maple Street
    Toronto, ON M1A 1B2
    Canada
  8. Deliver the package at your parcel shop.
  9. Once we have received your return, we will notify you by email. We give you a refund by the same method you used to pay within 14 days after your returned item(s) is received at our warehouse.

What is your return policy?

We accept returns within 30 days of receipt. The items must be in new and unused condition. Please note that some items such as clearance or personalized items may not be eligible for return.

How can I initiate a return?

To start a return, visit our 'Returns' page and follow the instructions provided. You can also reach out to our customer service team for assistance.

Will I be charged for returning a product?

Return shipping charges are the responsibility of the customer unless the return is due to a product defect or an error on our part.

How long does it take to process a return?

Once we receive the returned item, please allow up to 14 days for us to process your return and initiate a refund to the original payment method.
